scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @meow/contracts && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:run --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @meow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace frontend && npm run test:coverage --workspace backend
